title: Twelve Monkeys Hakuna Iced Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Hakuna Iced by Twelve Monkeys brings a refreshing balance of crisp Apple and tart Cranberry, enhanced with a cooling menthol twist. The juicy sweetness of Apple is complemented by the bold, slightly sharp notes of Cranberry, while an icy exhale rounds out the flavour with a brisk, frosty sensation. Designed with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Hakuna Iced is perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, ensuring dense vapour production and full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength to suit their preference. If you prefer this flavour without the cooling sensation, the original un-iced version is also available right here at Vapestore. Twelve Monkeys is a globally recognised Canadian e-liquid brand, celebrated for its innovative fruit blends and commitment to high-quality ingredients, providing a premium vaping experience.
